info.name: Dhanvantari Mobile App API (Admin + Delivery)
info.description:
End-to-end collection for /api/v1/app. Run folder by folder, top to bottom (or with the Collection Runner): logins save the tokens and each create request saves the ids the next requests use.

1. Set admin_username / admin_password (an admin account on the website) and, for folder 8, delivery_mobile / delivery_password.
2. base_url defaults to https://dhanvantari-naturals.com (use http://localhost:3000 locally).

All responses: { success, message?, data, meta? }. Errors: { success: false, message, errors? } with HTTP 400/401/403/404/422. Tokens are valid for 30 days.

request.description: Admin login with email or mobile + password (same admin account as the website). Saves admin_token.

exec: var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data.token) { pm.collectionVariables.set('admin_token', j.data.token); }

request.description: Today / this month bookings, pending deliveries, unpaid count + amount due, low-stock count.

item.name: Meta (statuses, paid_via, stores, delivery persons, categories)

exec: var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && (j.data[0] && j.data[0].id)) { pm.collectionVariables.set('delivery_person_id', (j.data[0] && j.data[0].id)); }

request.description: Matches name, mobile, email or area as the user types.
If the mobile already exists, returns that customer (200) instead of an error.

exec: var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('customer_id', j.data.id); }

item.name: Customer Details (+ recent bookings, amount due)

request.description: Type to search name / SKU / barcode. in_stock=1 → only in stock, low_stock=1 → at/below threshold. Saves the first product as product_id.

exec: var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && (j.data[0] && j.data[0].id)) { pm.collectionVariables.set('product_id', (j.data[0] && j.data[0].id)); }

var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data && j.data.variants && j.data.variants.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('variant_id', j.data.variants[0].id); } else { pm.collectionVariables.set('variant_id', ''); }

item.name: Edit Product (price, buying price, threshold, variants)

request.description: Optional: "variants": [{"id": 7, "selling_price": 60, "buying_price": 45, "b2b_price": 55, "low_stock_threshold": 3}]. Stock is changed with the Stock Adjustment request.
mode: set | add | remove. Adding creates a stock batch (needs cost_price if the product has no buying price). For a product with variants pass product_variant_id.

price omitted → product/variant selling price (B2B price for B2B customers). Invoice is generated immediately, same as admin. Instead of customer_id you can send customer_name + customer_phone (customer is linked/created by phone). payment_status: unpaid | paid (with paid_via cash/upi/bank). Out-of-stock lines return 422 with the reason.

body.raw:
{
  "booking": {
    "customer_id": "{{customer_id}}",
    "delivery_address": "",
    "store_id": null,
    "discount_amount": 0,
    "shipping_charges": 0,
    "notes": "Booked from mobile app",
    "payment_status": "unpaid",
    "paid_via": "",
    "expected_delivery_date": "",
    "expected_delivery_time": "",
    "delivery_person_id": "{{delivery_person_id}}",
    "items": [
      {
        "product_id": "{{product_id}}",
        "product_variant_id": "{{variant_id}}",
        "quantity": 1,
        "price": null,
        "discount_type": null,
        "discount_value": null
      }
    ]
  }
}

exec: var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('booking_id', j.data.id); }

item.name: Booking Details (items, invoice, location, WhatsApp links)

request.description: items: {id, quantity, price} edits a line, {id, _destroy: true} removes it, {product_id, product_variant_id, quantity} adds a line.
status: ordered_and_delivery_pending | packed | shipped | shop_pickup | rescheduled | reconfirm_order | delivered | cancelled (reason) | returned | refund

item.name: Set Delivery Date / Time / Delivery Person

request.description: Recorded on the booking's invoice; booking becomes partially_paid, or paid when the balance reaches 0.

item.name: WhatsApp: Send Invoice / Thank You / Reminder links

request.description: Returns wa.me links (open them on the phone) + the message texts: send_invoice, payment_thank_you (after payment), payment_reminder (unpaid).
paid_via: cash | upi | bank. Updates/creates the invoice and Sales Receipt like admin. Then use the WhatsApp payment_thank_you link.

Oldest first, with due_amount, days_since_booking, due_date (booking date + invoice due days), days_overdue, reminder_message and whatsapp_reminder_url. min_days=7 → only bookings at least 7 days old. meta.total_due = total outstanding.

exec: var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && (j.data[0] && j.data[0].id)) { pm.collectionVariables.set('vendor_id', (j.data[0] && j.data[0].id)); }
var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('vendor_id', j.data.id); }

request.description: Same as admin Vendor Purchase: creates stock batches for each line (variant lines add to the variant).

exec: var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('vendor_purchase_id', j.data.id); }

item.name: (Admin) Create Unpaid Booking assigned to Delivery Person

request.description: Setup step for this folder: an unpaid booking assigned to {{delivery_person_id}}, saved as delivery_booking_id.

body.raw:
{
  "booking": {
    "customer_id": "{{customer_id}}",
    "delivery_address": "",
    "store_id": null,
    "discount_amount": 0,
    "shipping_charges": 0,
    "notes": "For delivery app test",
    "payment_status": "unpaid",
    "paid_via": "",
    "expected_delivery_date": "",
    "expected_delivery_time": "",
    "delivery_person_id": "{{delivery_person_id}}",
    "items": [
      {
        "product_id": "{{product_id}}",
        "product_variant_id": "{{variant_id}}",
        "quantity": 1,
        "price": null,
        "discount_type": null,
        "discount_value": null
      }
    ]
  }
}

exec: var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('delivery_booking_id', j.data.id); }

request.description: Mobile (or email) + the password set in Admin → Delivery Persons. Saves delivery_token. The delivery person only sees bookings assigned to them.

exec: var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data.token) { pm.collectionVariables.set('delivery_token', j.data.token); }

request.description: scope: today | pending | delivered | all. Each row has location.maps_url for navigation.

exec: var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data[0] && !pm.collectionVariables.get('delivery_booking_id')) { pm.collectionVariables.set('delivery_booking_id', j.data[0].id); }

item.name: Route Map (today's stops + Google Maps directions)

request.description: Open data.directions_url in Google Maps for turn-by-turn route through all stops (up to 10). Each stop also has maps_url, phone and due_amount.
amount omitted/full → booking paid; less → partial payment.
status: shipped (out for delivery) | delivered | rescheduled
